title: Model-Agnostic Search for New Physics in the Presence of Imperfect Background by Smearing the Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.40734v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the search for new particles in high-energy physics, it is necessary to first define the signal region (SR) enriched in signal events, and then compare events in this region with the expected background distribution. While most existing search methods rely on prior domain knowledge of either the signal or the background, there has been less effort to relax both assumptions simultaneously, as methods that weaken one assumption typically rely on strong knowledge of the other. We propose Model-Agnostic Search with Smearing and Imperfect Background (MASSIB), a method that addresses this challenge by learning the density ratio of events relative to a misspecified background distribution using modern tools from machine learning, and defining the SR as the region with high density ratio. translated_title: 在不完美背景下通过对数据进行模糊化实现模型无关的新物理搜索
translated_abstract: 在高能物理中寻找新粒子时，需要首先定义富集信号事例的信号区（SR），然后将该区域中的事例与预期的背景分布进行比较。虽然现有的大多数搜索方法依赖于对信号或背景的先验领域知识，但很少有工作能同时放宽这两个假设，因为削弱其中一个假设的方法通常依赖于对另一个假设的强知识。我们提出了MASSIB（基于模糊化与不完美背景的模型无关搜索），该方法通过利用现代机器学习工具学习事例相对于错误设定的背景分布的密度比来解决这一挑战，并将信号区定义为密度比较高的区域。我们认识到，这一想法的朴素应用在从控制区向信号区内插时会引入显著的背景估计偏差……
tldr: 提出MASSIB方法，利用机器学习学习事例相对于错误设定背景分布的密度比来定义信号区，并通过数据模糊化修正背景估计偏差，从而在无需对信号和背景任何一方强先验知识的情况下实现模型无关的新物理搜索。
en_tdlr: MASSIB enables model-agnostic searches for new physics by learning the density ratio of events relative to a misspecified background distribution and using data smearing to correct background estimation bias, requiring no strong prior knowledge of either signal or background.
